description: Look up a subscriber in one mailing list by email address: ID, name, status (SubscribeType 1 subscribed, 2 unsubscribed, 3 bounced, 4 removed), custom fields, tags and preferences. Moosend: GET /subscribers/{MailingListID}/view.json?Email=.

mailing_list_id.description: Mailing list ID (a GUID, from moosend_list_mailing_lists).

name: moosend_get_subscriber_by_email
title: Find subscriber by email
